name: i18n.t
description: Looks up one message by key in the <locale>.json catalogs under catalog_dir, following the fallback chain requested language, its base language, then en, then the key itself. Selects a plural form by count and fills {name} placeholders from values. Reads only catalog files; writes nothing.

catalog_dir.description: Directory of <locale>.json catalogs such as da.json or pt_BR.json. Only regular files there whose names are a locale tag plus .json are read.

key.description: Message id to look up. It is also the English text when no catalog translates it.

language.description: Optional locale tag such as da_DK, da or ru. Without it, only the en fallback is consulted.

plural_key.description: Plural message id, given together with count. Its English form is used for counts other than one when no catalog translates it.

count.description: Nonnegative count that selects the plural form, given together with plural_key.

context.description: Optional message context that separates identical ids, such as menu.

values.description: Placeholder values by name. Each value is a string, number or boolean and is copied verbatim.
